items.text: Enter all scientific values explicitly. Sliders have display-only ranges; text entry retains off-tick and out-of-range values.
Omega uses explicit ordered real/imaginary pairs: three for triad, 3q for ring. New ring rows are blank; no repetition or normalization. update_index is separate from observer clocks.
eps, coupling g, phase_strength and the explicit k triple are the kernel parameters. k is not a spatial wave vector.
A historical preset or reference fill is an explicit action. Its source is shown; edits produce a user-supplied draft.
Recorded provenance known. Original design rationale unresolved where O02 applies.
PASSIVE OBSERVATION / DIAGNOSTIC. Selected observers and diagnostics do not feed back into Omega.
Structure/digest valid does not establish scientific replay or authenticate producer claims. Producer environment differs from the current viewer.
Resume preserves recorded parameters and observer configuration. A checkpoint is a new run with explicit selected observer clocks, configuration, memory and parent/sample provenance.
Independent geometry — no dynamic attachment. Numeric wireframes display returned exact nodes and incidence. Exact expressions remain inspectable.
Research concepts and quarantined modules are excluded from executable controls. No Omega-to-shell mapping is established.
Application software: Apache-2.0. Qt/PySide6/Shiboken use the LGPLv3 route and remain separately installed and replaceable. Third-party components retain their own notices.
Ring q controls the number of explicit triads: state_size=3q. It is UI row structure, not a new kernel parameter. Ring run has no observers, readouts or diagnostics.
Custom q, N, t, q_step and dt are explicit observer inputs. Clock dt is not a dynamics timestep. EMA m is explicit bounded memory; retention and innovation are not controls.
Converting a preset copies its displayed literals into a custom descriptor, retains an origin note and removes the historical claim. Literal user spellings are preserved.
Constructor-zero is an explicit run initialization, requiring update_index=0 and EMA m=0. Standalone observe calls recompute a readout and do not replay constructor-zero initialization.
Detached public-API analysis is application data, not a record or scientific replay certificate. Parent record identity is context, not independent current implementation identity.

Observer-vector coordinates are not physical placement. Stored scalar z and q feed explicitly requested history adapters. Kappa sqrt is a display-only conversion of a named recorded nonnegative diagnostic. Missing sources remain missing.

Torus coordinates normalize the entire supplied history once. R, r_max and N are explicit; the accepted domain is R > r_max > 0. Returned z_max, H_z and regularizer remain visible. Playback does not recompute prefixes.

Exact input supports integers, pi, parentheses, + - * /, rational powers (^ or **), sin and cos. No floats, variables or general code. UI guards: 2048 characters, 256 tokens, depth 32, 64 digits per integer, reduced power numerator/denominator at most 64. Composed expression-tree depth is also bounded at 32, with a conservative representation-growth budget of 4096.
C01 section heights preserve supplied order and repeats. Returned section segments are drawn directly; w, s and beta remain fixed and read-only.

D03 supports aligned(s,g_gap), from_radius(s,p), regular(s), paper_c_member(s), translate_paper_c_to_regular(s), shrink_paper_c_at_fixed_centres(s). Geometric g_gap differs from dynamics coupling g. Symmetry is descriptive; no inferred permutation action.

Playback moves through stored sample ordinals and displays the actual update_index separately. Frames per wall-clock second are unrelated to Clock.dt, updates or physical time. Display precision and visibility never alter stored bits.
